spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (मृणाति)
To hurt, to injure.

mn. (-लः-लं)
The film or fibres attached to the stalk of a lotus.
n. (-लं)
The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
f. (-ली)
A small fibre in the stalk of the waterlily.
E.
मृण to hurt, Uṇādi aff. कालन्.

m. (-ली)
A lotus.
f. (-लिनी)
An assemblage of lotus flowers.
E.
मृणाल a fibre, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of earth or clay, (as porcelain, &c.)
E.
मृत्, and मयट् aff.
